newsitem.title: USA: USDA to buy 1.440 mln lbs ham for school lunches.
newsitem.headline: USDA to buy 1.440 mln lbs ham for school lunches.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it plans to buy 1,440,000 lbs of frozen smoked fully cooked hams (Type II) for use in the National School Lunch Program.
All offers must be in the format prescribed in LS-50 and be received by 1400 EDT in Washington, D.C., on Monday, September 30, 1996. Acceptances will be announced by midnight Friday, October 4, 1996.
Shipments must be made between November 5 and 18, 1996.
